title: Sources and executives: the war in the Middle East disrupted crucial PCB raw material supplies; Goldman Sachs says PCB prices surged as much as 40% MoM in April (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: Sources and executives: the war in the Middle East disrupted crucial PCB raw material supplies; Goldman Sachs says PCB prices surged as much as 40% MoM in April — The conflict in the Middle East has disrupted supplies of crucial raw materials and pushed up prices of the printed circuit boards …
